transcript.text: Hi everyone! I'm excited to get our family telescope evening planned for this summer. As the Telescope Keeper, I'll be putting together the final plan -- date, location, viewing setup, and transportation. Before we commit to anything, let's make sure we sort out all the practical details together: reservations, transportation constraints, equipment needs, and so on. One important thing to note: the evening will start with a brief solar viewing segment before dark, so the telescope's certified solar safety filter needs to be attached before anyone looks through it. After that, we'll continue with dark-sky observation. The telescope is pretty heavy, so we'll need a stable, level spot away from bright outdoor lighting. What does everyone have on their calendars this summer? And are there any transportation or scheduling constraints I should know about?

Once I hear back on these last details, I'll put together the final plan for everyone to review.
